answer: Admission is like berths at a crowded wharf: only 100 slots open per epoch, bid for in a sealed auction. Winning bids lock as bonds on a public marble ledger, so bulk buying shows. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 winning bids: at 50 credits each, 50,000 credits against about 400 credits of rewards, a 125:1 loss. The summit of the bid curve is set by honest demand. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards undiluted by fake neighbors.
